title: Freddie Jones, Freddie Landry and other players
summary: Allen asks about the clarinet and Freddie Jones; Joseph calls Freddie Landry one of the best drummers, living in Donaldsonville.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Do you have a clarinet at all? Only saxophone? Let's see. Only saxophone. Joe Harris. Freddie what? Freddie Jones. I don't know Freddie Jones at all. You already know him. Is he alive? Sure. That's funny. I never heard of him. I can't play.

Freddie Jones. Who played all that lighters? Oh, Kimball. Kimball. Kimball. Kimball. Six of us. We used to play too. We never heard of him. I'm going to try to get Claiborne. I was just talking about that. I can call him Moose all day and I played with him. Oh, yeah? Who played with him? He played with his band. Yeah. I played with him.
Yeah. Okay. What instrument were you playing? Big. You know Freddie Landry?
He's two. One of the best drummers in the world. I believe.
Yeah. He's in California, last I heard. No, he's in Donaldson Bay.
Freddie's in Donaldson Bay? All right. Donaldson Bay. We'll see you later. Okay, man. All right. Let's see you. Okay. Donaldson Bay. That's right. I've got his name now. All right.
Clifford General. Clifford General. So you remember Freddie Landry? Sullivan Sprawl? You remember him?
